audit_title: Phase 4.4 Distributed Security and Consensus Hardening Findings
auditor: Principal Distributed Systems Architect & Formal Verification Specialist

findings.title: Stale Leadership Certificate Partition Mutation Vulnerability
findings.description: Deposed leader C1 in Term 1 could sign operation tokens using its private key and mutate an lagging storage node N1 that had not yet observed Term 2.
findings.remediation: Replaced unilateral coordinator signing with QuorumMutationPermit requiring explicit majority quorum (>=2 of 3 voters) verification on every storage mutation. Lagging storage node N1 rejects mutations without majority voter agreement.

findings.title: Commit Index Rollback / Delayed RPC Replay
findings.description: Delayed RPCs from prior terms or lower commit indices could arrive out of order and overwrite newer shard states.
findings.remediation: Added durable commit_index watermark tracking on storage nodes. Any mutation with commit_index < highest_seen_commit_index is rejected.

findings.title: Metadata Snapshot Rollback Vulnerability
findings.description: An adversary or network partition could present an outdated snapshot, rolling back the replicated log and commit index.
findings.remediation: Enforced snapshot rollback rejection in ReplicatedLogManager::install_snapshot (snapshot_index < commit_index returns StorageError::CorruptMetadata).

findings.title: Storage Node Restart Idempotency Cache Loss
findings.description: Storage node restarts cleared the in-memory executed_requests set, allowing request replay after reboot.
findings.remediation: Added executed_requests.rec write-and-sync persistence and load_or_init recovery in NodeEpochFencingTracker.

findings.title: Lack of Multi-Datacenter Physical Hardware Staging
findings.description: Protocol has been thoroughly verified on multi-process local network namespaces and deterministic simulation, but physical bare-metal multi-host deployment has not been provisioned.
findings.remediation: Created production systemd unit templates and cluster_5host.toml configuration; marked physical staging as NOT EXECUTED in final deliverables.
